THESEEKER-THE_BEST_DEFENSE_CARD.title: The Best Defense
THESEEKER-THE_BEST_DEFENSE_CARD.descript: Whenever you play an attack, gain 1 block. Scales with dexterity.
THESEEKER-CONJURE_UP.title: Conjure Up
THESEEKER-CONJURE_UP.description: Play a random Attack from your draw pile. Gain {Block:diff()} Block.
THESEEKER-ENDOW.title: Endow
THESEEKER-ENDOW.description: Deal {Damage:diff()} to an enemy 2 times. Choose an attack in your discard pile, it gains {Block} block.
THESEEKER-BLITZ.title: Blitz
THESEEKER-FLARE.title: Flare
THESEEKER-FLARE.description: Choose an attack in your hand, it gains {Block} block, Retain and Exhaust.
THESEEKER-MEDITATE.title: Meditate
THESEEKER-MEDITATE.description: Gain {Block:diff()} Block. At the start of your next turn, gain {StrengthPower:diff()} temporary Strength.
THESEEKER-OVERREACH.title: Overreach
THESEEKER-OVERREACH.description: Draw {Cards} cards, sacrifice 1 for each card drawn. Gain 1 temporary strength for each attack drawn, and 1 temporary dexterity for each skill drawn.
THESEEKER-POMODORO.title: Pomodoro
THESEEKER-POMODORO.description: Sacrifice {HpLoss:diff()}. At the start of your next turn, gain {Energy} energy.
THESEEKER-RECURRING_THOUGHT.title: Recurring Thought
THESEEKER-RECURRING_THOUGHT.description: Sacrifice {HpLoss} Deal {Damage:diff()} to all enemies twice. At the end of your turn, play this card from your discard pile.
THESEEKER-BYPASS.title: Bypass
THESEEKER-STAIN.title: Stain
THESEEKER-SHELL.title: Shell
THESEEKER-GIVE_AND_TAKE.title: Give and Take
THESEEKER-GIVE_AND_TAKE.description: Sacrifice {HpLoss:diff()}. Apply {TheSeekerDisintegrationPower:diff()} Disintegration to all enemies.
THESEEKER-SEE_ALL.title: See All
THESEEKER-SEE_ALL.description: Deal {Damage:difF()} damage to all enemies, gain 1 temporary dexterity for each enemy hit.
THESEEKER-SLOW_BURN.title: Slow Burn
THESEEKER-SLOW_BURN.description: Whenever an enemy takes disintegration damage, apply 1 disintegration.
THESEEKER-PAY_THE_PRICE.title: Pay the Price
THESEEKER-PAY_THE_PRICE.description: Gain {Block:diff()} block. At the start of next turn, sacrifice {HpLoss:diff()}.
THESEEKER-METHODICAL_LEARNER.title: Methodical Learner
THESEEKER-METHODICAL_LEARNER.description: Deal {Damage:diff()} to an enemy. This card gains 3 block this combat.
